title: Bentov, Puharich and Geller together in Tel Aviv

tellings.quote: cuz there's photographs of Geller, Puharich, and Bentov in an apartment in Tel Aviv together.

plain: In the 1970s three men, a scientist named Puharich, an inventor named Itzhak Bentov and the psychic Uri Geller, were together in an apartment in Tel Aviv, Israel, according to a researcher named Greg Malatzi. He says there are photographs of the three there, and he also points to tape recordings made by Puharich and Bentov. He raises it to show the three worked closely together.
